exercises.task: Write is1NF(): every value must be atomic — no arrays or nested objects. Then run the test.
exercises.hint: Object.values + every: reject typeof 'object' (but allow null).

exercises.task: Split customers out of orders (3NF): dedupe customers, slim the orders. Then run the test.
exercises.expectedOutput:
customers: 2
phones stored: 2
slim keys: order_id,customer
exercises.hint: Use a Map keyed by customer name to dedupe, then slim orders to id + name.

exercises.task: Write hasTransitiveDep(): spot when one city maps to two different tax rates. Then run the test.
exercises.hint: Track each city's taxRate in an object; a second, different rate means trouble.
